messages:
claire (PM): Quick sync 1 proposing a multi-quarter initiative I9m calling the Policy Runway. Aim: define routing primitives, SLA tiers, and a clear migration path so Sales can commit region-bounded SLAs. Need feedback on launch gates and prioritization.

sumit (Arch): +1. Recommend separating policy primitives (affinity, fallback, quarantine, throttles) from enforcement surfaces (runtime vs infra). Ship a policy DSL and UI first, then bind to slices.

diego (Eng): From engineering POV two parallel tracks: (1) low-latency routing decision engine, (2) infra for tenant-slices and capacity tags. Minimal prototype (single-region policy + synthetic traffic harness) could be ~8w if we scope tightly.

anya (SRE): Ops concerns: we must expose per-route telemetry (p95 latency, reject/drop counts, eviction events). Need rollback for policy flips 1 auto-fallback to global default. Also require chaos tests.

michael (Sales): Customers care about: 1) geo pinning + residency, 2) contractual SLA windows (99.9 regional), 3) protection from noisy neighbors. Several active deals need at least pinning + doc.

claire (PM): Draft launch criteria: (A) policy DSL v1 + docs/UI, (B) runtime routes + fallback with <10ms decision latency (p95), (C) ability to declare region-bound SLAs and demonstrate compliance for 2 weeks in staging, (D) published failover playbook and runbook. Thoughts?

sumit (Arch): Add gating: backward-compatible defaults for current customers and a migration plan for pinned customers. Also call out data residency/legal edge cases.

diego (Eng): Decision latency depends on cache strategy. With local prefix/KV cache we can hit sub-5ms for hot keys, but cold lookups to policy store will spike. Need clear cache TTL and invalidation rules. Example DSL snippet: 
```
route {
  match: tenant == "T-123" && region == "eu-west-1"
  action: route_to(slice:europe-primary) fallback: slice:eu-fallback
  propagation_ttl: 30s
}
```

anya (SRE): Suggest SLOs for propagation: policy propagation <60s for 95% of changes. Add chaos scenarios: region failover, burst isolation, API throttling. I9ll draft runbook steps for manual evacuate -> automated fallback.

michael (Sales): Prioritize a quick win: per-tenant regional pinning + customer-facing SLA FAQ. Sales can use that in negotiations before full slice isolation ships.

claire (PM): Proposed phased rollout: P0 = docs + DSL + opt-in per-tenant pinning; P1 = runtime routing + fallbacks + per-route metrics; P2 = tenant slices + reserved capacity + enforcement. Rough timeline: P0 = 4w, P1 = 12w, P2 = 24-36w.

sumit (Arch): Risks to surface: cross-region egress costs, KV cache consistency, legal/data residency corner cases, billing visibility for egress. Add dependency on billing for transparent customer pricing.

diego (Eng): Infra dependency: capacity tagging and slice allocation APIs. Autoscaling for reserved pools must differ from shared pools. Also need migration tool to rebind tenants to slices.

anya (SRE): Ops stub: when a slice is overloaded -> step 1 alert -> step 2 manual evac to fallback slice -> step 3 automated fallback policies triggered. Will open a PR for the runbook.

claire (PM): Action items: Sumit write initial DSL spec by EOW, Diego produce runtime + infra estimate by Friday EOD, Anya open runbook PR and chaos plan, Michael gather top-3 customer commitments and legal asks. I9ll collate into a roadmap doc for exec review.

deploy-bot: deploy starting: infra/prototyping/policy-dsl -> staging at 1819127200 1 check CI.

michael (Sales): One more: include a short customer FAQ on "what happens during regional failover" that we can share with legal and customers.

claire (PM): Noted; FAQ added to P0 deliverables. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
